closure_claim: Every voluntary federal income tax withheld amount reported in box 6 of a Form SSA-1099 furnished to the taxpayer or spouse for tax year 2025 is recorded as a statement item as of the keyed horizon. This claim covers Form SSA-1099 box 6 only: it says nothing about box 5 net benefits, repayments, or Social Security worksheet completeness. Closed with members authorizes the sum of current members; closed-empty authorizes subtotal 0.
title: Form SSA-1099 box 6 statement items, tax year 2025
